hypothesis: A week-over-week increase in the breadth of issuers with initial Form 4 open-market insider purchases identifies frozen V11 U.S.-equity de-risk events that are too early and can improve return while matching or exceeding V11 Sharpe and beating an availability-matched unconditional U.S.-retention control.
allowed_changes: F-SEC-INSIDER-BUY-BREADTH-US exact weekly breadth of distinct issuer CIKs with initial Form 4 NONDERIV_TRANS open-market purchase TRANS_CODE=P and acquired=A
risk-on exactly when current completed-week buy-issuer breadth exceeds the immediately previous completed-week breadth
completed Monday-Friday filing week usable on following Tuesday and stale after 10 calendar days
on factor-available frozen V11 U.S.-equity de-risk events retain exactly 50% of nasdaq/sp500 reductions when risk-on
selection_metric: No within-family model selection. Compare the single candidate against frozen V11 and C-SEC-INSIDER-ALWAYS, then apply every preregistered deterministic, bootstrap and cumulative DSR gate.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe
deterministic: gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
bootstrap: paired circular moving blocks, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260821
PBO: not applicable because the family contains exactly one candidate and no within-family selection
global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using prior 28 formal return-seeking candidates plus F-SEC-INSIDER-BUY-BREADTH-US, total trial count 29
ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: This SEC-insider campaign contains exactly one retrospective candidate. After formal performance is viewed, do not search sales, buy/sell ratios, net purchases, dollar/share weighting, market-cap weighting, issuer-size filters, reporting-owner subgroups, alternate weekly/multiweek windows, z-scores, percentiles, breadth thresholds, magnitude thresholds, sign reversals, availability variants, retention fractions, Form 4/A amendment incorporation or a second retrospective SEC-insider family. A promising non-robust result may only become a separately preregistered prospective shadow from a new freeze date.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_sec_insider_buy_breadth_v1.py -> tools/sec_insider_buy_breadth_v1.swiftpart + tools/sec_insider_buy_breadth_v1_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: V11-CONTROL metrics and frozen target fingerprint
all seven fixed fold metrics plus 2020+ and 2022+ slices
source/U.S.-de-risk/available/retained event counts and portfolio constraints
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 result artifact manifest

factor_definition.breadth_rule: count distinct ISSUERCIK values with at least one qualifying filing in each completed Monday-Friday filing week
factor_definition.delta_rule: current weekly distinct-issuer count minus immediately previous completed-week count
factor_definition.availability_rule: completed filing week usable on following Tuesday

matched_control.rule: retain exactly 50% of nasdaq/sp500 reductions on every factor-available frozen V11 U.S.-de-risk event regardless of insider-buy breadth change

shared_rules.event_scope: unique execution dates on which frozen V11 report.trades is non-empty
shared_rules.eligible_event: current frozen V11 event reduces nasdaq and/or sp500 versus prior frozen V11 event target

forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path rule change
using Form 4/A amendments to rewrite the historical information set
using sales, buy/sell ratios, net purchases, transaction values or shares
using director/officer/10-percent-owner subgroup selection or issuer-size filtering
using market-cap weighting or any survivorship-filtered index membership
using alternate weekly or multiweek windows, moving averages, z-scores, percentiles or thresholds
using same-day, next-day, following-Monday or another availability rule
using any 25%, 75%, 100% or other retention-fraction search
factor-driven trades between frozen V11 event dates
candidate replacement or a second retrospective SEC-insider factor after results
changing fee/slippage, leverage, financing, shorting or cash constraints
dropping failed prior formal candidates from cumulative DSR accounting
